messages.1000001:
Hey, you must be new to this area.  Nice to meet you.
I'm Burns, an Elf Ranger.
messages.1000002:
Humans are kind enough around here
to keep their promise to minimize damage
when cutting trees.
messages.1000003:
Thanks to their consideration, we elves can live peacefully
alongside them.  I hope you understand that, too.
messages.1000004:
Nowadays, the forest is being destroyed by monsters.
I don't know what we'll do...
messages.1000005: Well, from now on, please take care of the forest, too.
messages.1000006:
Hi. There's nothing we can do against the monsters in this forest.
At any rate, keep away from the danger.
messages.1000007:
Our forest...
There's no greater pain than watching the forest be damaged.
messages.1000008:
Oh, I received some information from Uta!
I had doubts about Gebal's activities several times in the past.
messages.1000009:
Seems he allied himself with rotten nobles who made undue profits,
and he's gone too far this time.
messages.1000010:
I already told some honorable nobles and the Guild
merchants about it. If a real investigating commission focused
on the garden, the truth would be revealed.
messages.1000012:
Some of the elves that don't like human beings are likely to
take political advantage of this matter.
messages.1000013:
They'll say that we cannot trust human beings anymore.
They may ask for compensation and for humans to leave the forest.
messages.1000014:
These elf politicians maintain their influence by fueling
hate among elves. They poke their noses
into everything and make things more complicated.
messages.1000015:
We shouldn't destroy the relationship
that took us so long to build.
messages.1000016:
This forest has benefitted
from the friendship between human beings and elves.
messages.1000017: ...Let me tell you more about it one day if you have time.
messages.1000019:
Something bad is happening, but I have an idea. It may seem too dangerous.
Do you want to at least hear about it?
messages.1000020:
Ferocious tarantulas started settling in the Forest of Silence
recently. Because they are strong enough to destroy the forest,
some Elf Rangers sacrificed their lives to try and defeat them.
messages.1000021:
We elves are afraid that they'll breed,
but there's really nothing we can do about it.
messages.1000022:
If human beings got rid of the Tarantulas, the problem would be
solved. Human beings match up well against them.
messages.1000023:
I heard from the Sacred Knight Royx
that you are a very capable warrior.
It may be a tough, but would you lend us a hand?
Please think about it.
messages.1000024:
It is rare for Royx and Uta to admit that a warrior can
be so capable, but now that I've met you,
I don't think it's so strange.
messages.1000025:
Oh! You made it! I worried that I sent you on an impossible
mission. I'm glad you succeeded in destroying them.
messages.1000026:
With your help, this Forest of Silence will recover and regain
its tranquility.  I appreciate your efforts.  Thank you very much!
messages.1000027: Oh, there is more good news!
messages.1000028:
Gebal's illegal market operations and doings with bad
nobles were revealed.  He had a secret stock of medicine.
messages.1000029:
With the garden owner's consent
to distribute medicine to everyone,
the virus threat should subside.
messages.1000030:
Well,
Gebal won't be allowed to do business for a while because of this.
messages.1000031:
And no one will want to deal with him
since he has shamed elves everywhere.
messages.1000032:
I heard that Gebal might lose everything
because he invested all of his money in herbs.
messages.1000033:
He was blind with greed and paid a high price for it.
What a miserable man.
messages.1000034:
In the future, we will train him to do physical work
like we do!
 
Wa ha ha !(cheerful laugh)
